GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , had tough run 3 Wide No Cover Mid Field before getting cover middle stages 3 Lengths 1000m, weakened in Straight # tough run
Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths Went Forward 3 Wide 2nd 3 Lengths 1200m 2nd 3 Lengths 800m 2nd 2 Lengths home turn 3 Wide 2nd Middle Of Track Kept Going Ok Straight # honest run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide, without cover, throughout the early and middle stages by the choice of its rider.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well sat rail 4l off, off rail turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off all clear, 1 length off approaching 100m, kept finding the line late # had run/good

Jumped well. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field on inside (5L from lead). Back 1 length midrace & pushed to quicken @ 650m. Improving 3 Wide @ 500m & pushed along 3 Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 250m & chased steadily in last 200m. # Steady effort.

Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths Two Wide , shifted 3 Wide at 550m, Moved Up to trail 3 Wide by a half length turning, hit Lead 250m, kept going to post, joined (DH) right on the line # battled on well
Jumped Well , Settled Down Two Wide 8th all of 7 Lengths @ 750m. on heels Straightening Up and to 225m. then Clear and passed a few. 1st 2 out 1st 2 home # ok once Clear
Jumped Ok sat 5l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off all clear, kept on one pace # held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To be ridden further forward; settled midfield. Rdr reported that after obtaining a midfield position, the mare failed to travel through the early and middle stages and came under pressure from near the 600m. He said the mare was disappointing in the manner in which it failed to finish its race off and added it did not feel entirely comfortable in its action. A post-race vet exam revealed the mare to be lame (1/5) in the off foreleg. Co-trainer was advised a vet clearance would be required prior to next race/trial. Vet clearance since received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 5l off, limited room turn, Straightening Up 3l off, battled on strong to the line # sound
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported that he intended to settle in a forward position. However, when it became apparent his mount would be caught wide in the early stages, he elected to shift the mare in behind runners to obtain cover towards the rear of the field.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat rail 4l off, off rail turn, Straightened Up 1 length off and battled on strong to the line # found 1 better
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Had some difficulty securing clear running rounding the home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well sat handy 2 Lengths off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off all clear, battled on well, got warm late # good 4 further
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in on jumping and made contact with another rnr. Near the 250m was inconvenienced by another rnr which shifted in slightly.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well faced breeze 1 length off, pushed along turn, Straightened Up half off, 1 length off 200m, kept finding the line late # breeze/kept finding
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 300m was taken out after being bumped.
